doctrine.rule: Django is the only canonical owner of canonical entities. Drizzle may read canonical entities ONLY as explicit governed projections (never full-shape db.select()/db.query full-shape). No entity may be declared as a canonical table in two ORMs. Authority flows Django model -> physical schema -> generated read projections; never reverse-generate a Django model from runtime physical drift.

ownerKinds.DJANGO_CANONICAL: Canonical entity owned by exactly one Django model/app. Physical DDL is produced only by Django migrations.
ownerKinds.DRIZZLE_SCOPED: Non-canonical scoped read-model/cache/app-local table legitimately owned by Drizzle (ue_cache.* / projection surfaces). Never a canonical business entity.
ownerKinds.PLATFORM_AUTH: Owned by @nzila/platform-auth (opaque PG sessions / auth plumbing).
ownerKinds.EXTERNAL_READONLY: Externally provisioned; runtime reads self-scoped rows only under RLS; no ORM emits DDL.

invariants.note: A canonical (REQUIRED_NOW) table with zero owners, or with two canonical owners, is a release-blocking authority defect. The verifier (schema:contract:verify) and lint (schema:authority:lint) enforce these two counts stay 0.
